{{Quote|The Jedi Council will assign you a new Master to oversee your final trials. You'll be tested in ways you can't imagine. But when you leave Tython, you'll know what it means to be a Jedi Knight. More importantly, you'll know yourself.|Derrin Weller|audio=Weller-NewMaster-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
'''Derrin Weller''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Charged with the protection of the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] grounds in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region, Weller received new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] upon their arrival to Tython at the [[Masters' Retreat]], though his duties were interrupted in [[3643 BBY]] when Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s launched an [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attack]] on the training grounds.

Forced to order a [[Hero of Tython|newly–arrived]] apprentice into battle against the Flesh Raiders, Weller joined the fight to defend the training grounds after informing the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of the situation, but he soon received a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] wound from a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]&ndash;wielding Flesh Raider while rescuing several Padawans. Fortunately for Weller, the injury was non-[[Death/Legends|fatal]], and he was quickly evacuated to a nearby [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Flesh Raiders are a species of hostile natives. They're smart enough to use tools and violent beyond reason. I'm sending every able-bodied Jedi down to the Padawan training grounds right away&mdash;especially you.|Derrin Weller, to the young apprentice|audio=Weller-FleshRaiders-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
[[File:Weller-Initiates-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|Derrin Weller greeted newcomers to Tython.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Derrin Weller was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and had risen to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Weller oversaw the Order's [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] grounds in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to the north of the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He maintained an office at the nearby [[Masters' Retreat]], where he greeted newly&ndash;arrived apprentices and gave them information on the Order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] before sending them to the Temple to meet with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. In this capacity, Weller greeted a [[Hero of Tython|young initiate]] who had been trained under several [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and had a reputation as an expert [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duelist]] despite the learner's youth, but his plans to send the student on a [[Air taxi/Legends|speeder]] to the Temple were interrupted by an emergency signal that reached his office.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

The message was from the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Unaw Aharo]], who frantically explained that the [[Flesh Raider]]s&mdash;Tython's violent native [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;were attacking the training grounds and were using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Disturbed by the possibility that the Flesh Raiders might be using advanced weaponry, Weller dispatched every available [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the Retreat down to the training grounds, including the young apprentice who had just arrived, while he contacted the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. After he reported the [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attack]] on the [[Gnarls Outpost]] to Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]] and the rest of the Council, Weller himself joined the battle against the Flesh Raiders, but he was shot in the [[Limb/Legends|leg]] while rescuing several Padawans.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

[[File:Derrin_Weller_injured.png|thumb|left|160px|Derrin Weller contacts the initiate]]
While preparing to be evacuated to a nearby [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], Weller contacted the apprentice from earlier and ordered the young Jedi to follow up on Aharo's transmission&mdash;locate the [[Gnarls cave|cave entrance]] through which the Flesh Raiders were entering the Gnarls and to stop them at the source. After reassuring the student that Master Din was also heading to the cave as reinforcements, Weller terminated the transmission and received treatment for his wound. Following Weller's orders, the apprentice discovered that the Flesh Raiders were being led by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] named [[Callef]], and the young Jedi [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|defeated]] Callef in battle before Din arrived to seal the tunnel.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|'There is no ignorance, there is knowledge.' Enter your training with an open mind. You might surprise yourself.|Derrin Weller|audio=Weller-OpenMind-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
Derrin Weller was fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Weller was calm and reserved in bearing, and he was more than willing to share his knowledge with the young Jedi whom he greeted upon their arrival to Tython. He maintained the same cool head when tense situations arrived, and he understood the value of knowing one's enemy before engaging in battle. Once Weller was wounded in combat, he allowed himself to be evacuated to a medcenter but ensured that the battle would go in the Order's favor despite his absence by sending Master Din and the young apprentice to seal the cave tunnel.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Never rush into a fight before knowing your enemy.|Derrin Weller|audio=Weller-NeverRush-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
A Jedi Knight charged with the protection of the training grounds in the Gnarls, the Force-sensitive Weller was a competent [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combatant]] and proficient in the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He was able to single-handedly rescue several Padawans from many attacking Flesh Raiders, though he received a leg wound in the process.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Equipment==
During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on Tython, the man wore dark [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] like many other Jedi on the world.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have completed an investigation into the Twi'lek Pilgrims and their corrupt leaders who collaborated with the rogue Jedi Bengel Morr.|Derrin Weller, in his message to the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Report on Tython">{{TORcite|type=message|Report on Tython's Twi'lek Pilgrim population|Warden Derrin Weller}}</ref>}}
Derrin Weller first appears in "Attack of the Flesh Raiders," the opening mission for the Jedi Knight class in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He welcomes new players to Tython and sends them into the Gnarls to fight the Flesh Raiders, and later contacts players to send them to find the cave that the Flesh Raiders are using to enter the Gnarls. Despite having an office in the Masters' Retreat, Weller is referred to as "Knight Weller" in all conversations.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> Players who choose [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] options in the mission "Dark Temptations," in which the player can choose whether to spare, [[Death/Legends|kill]], or depose the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ranna Tao'Ven]] as [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] of [[Kalikori village]] after she participates in a failed plot to kill the player, will receive a message from Weller regarding the situation in Kalikori, as he has been appointed as [[Warden/Legends|warden]] there.<ref name="Report on Tython" />

Players who chose to kill Tao'Ven are informed that the new Matriarch is far more cooperative with the Jedi than Tao'Ven&mdash;who was reported as being killed by Flesh Raiders&mdash;while players who chose to depose her learn that Tao'Ven's successor accepts Jedi law and submits to the Order's authority.<ref name="Report on Tython" /> Players who chose the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] option of sparing her receive messages from Tao'Ven herself regarding her current situation,<ref name="Atonement">{{TORcite|type=message|Atonement|Ranna Tao'Ven}}</ref> and this article assumes that the player chooses only the moral light side options as a Republic Jedi Knight character.<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> Weller is also mentioned in the mission "Early Lessons" when Jedi Knight players speak with Master [[Relnex]] at the Gnarls Outpost, while the conversation for [[Jedi Consular]] players mentions [[Yuon Par]] instead.<ref name="Early Lessons">{{TORcite|type=general|Early Lessons|Tython}}</ref>
